card.name: Digits inside ISBN and volume numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a number in a bibliography citation, mostly inside an ISBN and sometimes a journal volume number. It fires on the digits after the first one or two, not the opening digit.

modes.label: ISBN digits
modes.description: A digit partway through an ISBN in a book citation.

modes.label: Journal volume digits
modes.description: A digit in the volume number of a journal reference.

card.plain: It marks a digit in the middle of a book or journal reference number, as in an ISBN.
